subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Does the documented no-go satisfy this issue’s stop condition, or should one additional bounded shared-entry experiment be scheduled?
rationale: The planned experiment completed successfully as an investigation but produced no code improvement, while the broader bundle-reduction objective remains unresolved; automation cannot decide whether that negative result is terminal.

options.title: Accept the no-go
options.body: Treat the failed same-base extraction as satisfying the investigation, preserve the measurements, and close the issue manually.

options.title: Select another boundary
options.body: Keep the issue open only after naming one specific cross-route import boundary and a material compressed-byte threshold for a second A/B.

recommendation.title: Accept the no-go
recommendation.body: Treat the failed same-base extraction as satisfying the investigation, preserve the measurements, and close the issue manually.

likelyOwner.reason: They defined and executed the experiment and are best positioned to clarify whether its explicit stop condition was intended to complete the issue.
